title: Anthropic announces closing of initial public offering, including full exercise of underwriters’ option to purchase additional shares, and closing of concurrent private placement
author: Anthropic
description: Today Anthropic, PBC announced the closing of its initial public offering of an aggregate of 1,127,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock at a public offering price of $83.00 per share, including the full exercise by the underwriters of their option to purchase an additional 147,000,000 shares of Class A common…
summary: The offering consisted of 1,103,351,354 shares sold by Anthropic and 23,648,646 shares sold by certain selling stockholders. The aggregate gross proceeds from the offering, before deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and other offering expenses, were approximately $93.5 billion, of which approximately $91.6 billion was received by Anthropic.
takeaways: Morgan, Citigroup, Barclays, Wells Fargo Securities, BofA Securities, Deutsche Bank Securities, RBC Capital Markets, and UBS Investment Bank acted as book-running managers for the offering.
BMO Capital Markets, BNP Paribas, Credit Agricole CIB, Jefferies, Mizuho, MUFG, and TD Securities acted as additional book-running managers for the offering.
BTIG, Cantor, Capital One Securities, Macquarie Capital, and Societe Generale acted as co-managers for the offering.
